text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Symons Street from Royal York Road to Dwight Avenue, 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Symons Street from Royal York Road to Dwight Avenue, to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (south) side of Symons Street from Royal York Road to Dwight Avenue.
